请先在队列中选中要更换封面的文件。: Select the files whose covers you want to replace in the queue first.
预览已清空，二维码内容、模型和文字设置已保留。: Preview cleared. QR content, model choices and text settings have been kept.
自动避让模式由 AI 选择位置；生成前只显示底图，生成后显示实际融合结果。切换到: In automatic avoidance mode, AI chooses the position. The preview shows only the base image before generation, and the actual blended result afterward. Switch to manual placement with automatic prompts to position the QR yourself.
自动避让模式：生成前只显示底图，AI 将自动选择二维码位置。: Automatic avoidance: the preview shows only the base image before generation. AI will choose the QR position.
选择模型类型、配套二维码 ControlNet 与生图环境。切换方案保留已下载文: Select a model family, matching QR ControlNet and inference environment. Switching retains downloaded files. SD 1.5 and SDXL weights can coexist and share a compatible environment.
本地模型可选择完整 Diffusers 目录或完整 safetensors 文件: Choose a complete Diffusers directory or complete safetensors file. Ordinary Canny / Depth ControlNet models are not QR ControlNet models; confirm that a custom ControlNet was trained for QR codes.
提示词按当前模型保存。内置方案使用底图材质和风格，不猜测人物与服装。自定义模型默: Prompt settings are saved for each model. Built-in profiles use source materials and style without guessing people or clothing. Custom models initially use their family profile and have not all been tested; configure model-specific trigger words below when required.
为选中模型自定义自动提示词与参数: Customize automatic prompts and parameters for this model
正向模板（保留 {prompt}，可加入模型专用触发词）: Positive template (keep {prompt}; add model-specific trigger words)
0 使用配套自动参数；皮肤重绘强度仍受保护上限限制。SDXL 使用默认 CLIP: 0 uses the automatic profile value. Skin denoising remains capped for protection. SDXL uses its default CLIP layers.
仅支持常规 SD 1.5 / SDXL 四通道基础模型。SD2、FLUX、SD3: Only conventional four-channel SD 1.5 / SDXL base models are supported. SD2, FLUX, SD3, Refiner, Inpaint and special Turbo / Lightning / LCM setups cannot use these defaults. Loading a model does not prove fusion or decoding success.
选择完整模型目录，或完整 safetensors 文件。: Choose a complete model directory or a complete safetensors file.
模型提示词方案与模型类型不匹配。: The prompt profile does not match the model family.
请选择支持的模型提示词方案。: Select a supported model prompt profile.
模型生成参数超出支持范围。: Model generation parameters are outside the supported range.
自定义模板必须保留 {prompt} 与 {negative} 占位符。: Custom templates must retain the {prompt} and {negative} placeholders.
所选模型不完整或类型不受支持，请重新扫描 / 校验模型。: The selected model is incomplete or unsupported. Rescan / verify models.
模型方案已切换；点击下载 / 修复，或一键 AI 生成自动准备所选资源。: Setup changed. Click Download / Repair, or One-click AI generation to prepare the selected resources automatically.
默认方案：SD 1.5 · DreamShaper 8 · QR Monster: Default setup: SD 1.5 · DreamShaper 8 · QR Monster SD 1.5 · CUDA / CPU compatible environment. Click One-click AI generation to prepare missing resources. Other models download only when selected.
默认方案已选定；点击一键 AI 生成即可自动准备。: Default setup selected. Click One-click AI generation to prepare it automatically.
自动下载：QR Monster SD 1.5（默认推荐）: Download automatically: QR Monster SD 1.5 (recommended default)
默认使用 SD 1.5、DreamShaper 8、QR Monster SD: The default setup uses SD 1.5, DreamShaper 8, QR Monster SD 1.5 and the compatible environment. Other models and the separate CPU environment are alternatives and download only when selected. Switching retains downloaded files.
自动避让模式由 AI 选择位置；生成前只显示底图，生成后显示实际融合结果。切换到: In automatic avoidance mode, AI chooses the position. The preview shows the base image before generation and the blended result afterward. Switch to manual placement to choose the position yourself.
「自动避开皮肤与头发放置」与「手动放置（位置由你指定）」最多勾选一个，也可全部关: Select at most one of "Automatically place away from skin and hair" and "Manual placement (you choose the position)", or turn both off. "Caption image and create prompt automatically" controls prompts independently; turn it off to edit the prompt yourself.
手动提示词（关闭「自动识别画面并生成提示词」后可编辑）: Manual prompt (turn off "Caption image and create prompt automatically" to edit)
